title: Caroline yacht 1933 expedition and Stephenson dinner in Nassau

tellings.quote: That was a base of operations for Stevenson and that when the Caroline was parked at the port in Nassau, that Stevenson came on board and had dinner with him.

plain: In 1933, the yacht Caroline, belonging to a man named Eldridge Reeves Johnson, is said to have docked at Nassau in the Bahamas during an expedition, and William Stephenson, who used Nassau as a base of operations, came aboard and had dinner with Johnson. Paul Schatzkin tells it, without naming a source, in a documentary on the show about Townsend Brown, a scientist the film says built UFO-like craft, as part of tracing who was in contact with whom.
